jobs.description: Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code. We're scaling our Deal Desk function and looking for a high-ownership IC to join the Americas team. You'll sit at the intersection of Sales, Legal, Finance, Product, and Business Operations, partnering closely with Americas sales leaders to structure and win the enterprise deals that form the backbone of our growth — and just as importantly, you'll help us systematize and scale how we get those deals done. About the role We're in-person with cozy offices in North Beach, San Francisco and Manhattan, New York, complete with well-stocked libraries. This role requires five days a week in office. You'll be joining a small, high-ownership team operating in one of the fastest-moving markets in AI. The Deal S&O function is established and humming with deal volume — but we're growing fast enough that "established" doesn't mean "settled." Day-to-day, you'll be in the trenches on live deals, working through pricing negotiation and contract structure alongside sales leaders in real time. You'll also zoom out: scoping and shipping the strategic projects that take what's working today and make it work at 5x the volume — improving our pricing model, tightening approval workflows, scaling our contracting process, and building the sales enablement that lets reps move faster without losing the plot on commercial discipline. What you’ll do - Partner with Americas sales, legal, finance, and revenue operations to structure, negotiate, and close complex enterprise deals - Serve as a thought partner to sales reps on deal strategy: pricing, competitive positioning, negotiation approach, contract structure, executive engagement - Help evolve our pricing model and deal frameworks as the market and customer base shift — spotting trends across your deal flow, surfacing the patterns to finance and leadership, and driving the changes through - Lead cross-functional projects that systematize how we operate at scale — approval workflows, contracting playbooks, pricing guardrails, sales enablement materials, deal desk operating cadence - Improve the tools and processes we already have (Salesforce, Ironclad, our pricing infrastructure) by partnering with the GTM systems team — without needing to build them yourself - Balance a high-volume deal workload with longer-horizon strategic initiatives, managing competing priorities across multiple reps and deal cycles simultaneously You may be a fit if - You have 5–10 years of experience across consulting, investing, commercial strategy, deal desk, or a combination — and you've operated at a level where you owned outcomes, not just tasks - You've worked on enterprise B2B deals, ideally in SaaS or infrastructure, and have direct experience with $1M+ ACV contracts - You've operated in a high-volume deal environment and have a track record of scaling yourself — building processes, playbooks, and enablement so you're not the bottleneck - You're highly analytical — comfortable analyzing pricing, building ROI models in Excel, and grounding strategic recommendations in data - You have a point of view. You don't wait to be told what to think — you come with a perspective and know how to back it up - You operate with urgency, ownership, and very little hand-holding - You're based in or able to relocate to San Francisco or New York City

SpaceXAI is looking for a highly skilled and versatile OT (Operational Technology) Systems Engineer to implement and support the backend infrastructure for our next-generation controls and industrial software platforms for our physical infrastructure. Design, deploy, and augment next-generation OT environments that support plant and launch systems across multiple sites.
Install, configure, maintain, and support industry standard controls software platforms as well as internally developed HMIs.
Integrate established and emergent IT technologies to simplify management, improve security, and create scalable plant environments.
Deploy and maintain development, test, and staging environments to enable controlled, systematic change introduction.
Provide direct support during launch, test, and production campaigns.
Perform systems/software upgrades and maintenance between critical operations (including evenings and weekends as needed).
Proactively monitor services and respond rapidly to incidents to maintain high availability and performance.
Leverage automation tools and contribute to infrastructure-as-code and broader DevOps initiatives with a focus on ICS environments.
Work with internal controls engineers to iterate on simulation and emulation environment to enhance test coverage and augment change control processes.
Write and maintain standards, architectures, best practices, and documentation (including system overviews, design drawings, and operational procedures), with emphasis on highly reliable and secure industrial environments, especially at data boundaries.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (IT, security, controls, and operations) as well as external customers and integrators to design robust OT architectures and resolve technical issues.
Ensure OT systems are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g., Purdue Model, IEC 62443).

3+ years of experience in OT systems engineering or industrial control systems administration.
Hands-on experience with multiple industry standard controls software platforms and tools.
Significant experience designing, deploying, supporting, and troubleshooting OT environments in high-reliability settings.
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Experience supporting real-time systems, industrial control networks, or operational technology (OT) environments in aerospace, defense, energy, or similar high-reliability industries.
Experience designing architectures that incorporate hyperconverged, rugged industrial edge, and distributed compute technologies.
Working knowledge of industrial protocols, controls networks, and OT cybersecurity best practices.
Proficiency in scripting (Bash/PowerShell/Python) and automation frameworks (Puppet, Terraform, Ansible, etc.).
Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and DevOps concepts/tools.
Familiarity with Active Directory, multi-platform authentication, and identity environments in OT contexts.
System administration experience managing Windows and Linux servers, rudimentary database administration exposure, and storage/backup experience.
Network administration experience and understanding of the OSI model, especially Layer 1/2/3 considerations as they apply to industrial and controls networks.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, and management in both formal and informal situations.

Willingness to participate in an after-hours on-call rotation and work extended hours or weekends as necessary.
Willingness to travel (up to 20%, including flying to other sites worldwide) and potential time at sea supporting marine systems.

jobs.description: WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON Your main challenge You will support the Principal Activations Manager in bringing exciting IP collaborations and in-game activations to life, ensuring our upcoming roadmap is implemented in the best possible way for our players. You will work closely with our game and marketing teams to develop engaging experiences while coordinating with external IP partners to ensure assets and content meet their guidelines and approval requirements. What it means on a daily basis Contribute to the creative concept of in-game activations and how each IP can best be integrated into the game, from characters and cars to dialogue, content and game modes. Support the Principal Activations Manager in coordinating activations from concept through implementation. Collaborate with the game team to turn activation concepts into engaging experiences for players. Ensure marketing plans around each activation, including social media, influencer campaigns and other promotional initiatives, are aligned with the in-game experience. Gather, share and monitor IP guidelines to ensure in-game content and promotional materials meet partner requirements. Coordinate the creation and approval of promotional assets, including trailers, web assets, screenshots and store descriptions. Track the status of activation deliverables and communicate progress across the different teams involved. Research potential IPs and collaboration opportunities based on player insights, market trends and audience fit. Propose new concepts, themes and opportunities that could strengthen the future activations roadmap. What success will look like You help deliver activations on time and to a high standard, keeping internal teams and external partners aligned throughout the process. You understand our players and use available insights to contribute relevant ideas for IP collaborations and in-game experiences. As you grow into the role, you become increasingly autonomous in coordinating activations, identifying opportunities and contributing ideas to the future roadmap. Who you would be working with You will work directly with the Principal Activations Manager as part of the Operational Marketing team, collaborating with Product, ASO, Partnerships, Community, Influencer Marketing, User Acquisition and Marketing Art. You will also work closely with production teams including Producers, Game Design, Art, QA and Game Economy to coordinate the development and implementation of each activation. Externally, you will interact with IP rights holders and partners , as well as Licensing and Legal teams when required. Your recruitment journey Recruiter interview Hiring manager interview Case study / test Final interview Where this role can take you This role will give you hands-on experience at the intersection of gaming, entertainment, IP partnerships and live operations , with increasing ownership over activations and opportunities to contribute to the future direction of our collaboration roadmap. Fluent English , both written and spoken, with the ability to produce clear and engaging copy. Strong organizational skills, with the ability to track multiple deliverables and priorities simultaneously. Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple teams and stakeholders. Creative thinking and the ability to turn ideas into relevant concepts for in-game activations. Strong communication skills, particularly when coordinating feedback, requirements and approvals.
